A-F4 [Nit] review-a: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:246-251 does not reserve the temporary file name exclusively. A forced name collision lets one writer rename the bytes of another writer. Fix: open the temporary file with the `wx` flag and retry on a collision. Related: B-F10.

Fix: reserve each id across both series folders. The same defect is B-F8 of review-b and ADV-S8-4.

B-F9 [Nit] review-b: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:231-236 reads the stored look and writes it back with no lock between the two steps. A look-less write can undo a parallel explicit look change. A shipped classic marker stays. Fix: serialize the writes of one project. The same defect is ADV-S8-5.

B-F10 [Nit] review-b: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:245-249 builds a guessable temporary name and opens it with the default flag. A local symlink at that name is followed. The rename changes mode 640 to 664, and .gitignore:22 does not cover a stale project.json.tmp-* file. An attacker needs write access to the project folder. Fix: use the `wx` flag and a random name from crypto.randomBytes. The same defect is ADV-S8-6.
